In June, the FDA approved its first new sunscreen filter in 25 years with the addition of BEMT, an ingredient that’s been widely available in Europe since 2000. Glossy sat down with the gm and formulator behind La Roche-Posay, L’Oréal Group’s sunscreen leader, to learn how the brand is leveraging the new filter to grow awareness and sales.

title: Why beauty shoppers are flocking to Trader Joe’s
summary: The California-based national chain has long cultivated a devoted fan base unlike other grocery stores thanks to its mix of inventive snacks and treats, colorful branding and affordable prices. But shoppers are increasingly expanding the fervor they feel for Trader Joe’s core food offerings to its growing beauty aisle.
